US person on W-9. Paid gross."}],"notes":"Schedule for D-001 (Atlas Growth Fund I LP, record date 2026-10-30, payment date 2026-11-16) is prepared through step 9 and is unsigned. Nothing was written to the database and no cases were opened or closed. Rates are in percent.

RECONCILIATION (C3.4)
- Component D-001-A (US-source dividend from Orion via Atlas Acquisition SPV): gross 10,000,000.00, tax 1,465,562.50, net 8,534,437.50.
- Component D-001-B (return of capital): gross 2,000,000.00, tax 0, net 2,000,000.00.
- Total: gross 12,000,000.00, tax 1,465,562.50, net 10,534,437.50. Gross ties to notice DOC-0201 and to the 24 treasury lines.
- The two intermediary payees are split to the parties whose income it is. I-010, I-011 and I-012 sum to the Atlas Lux Feeder (I-002, CP-102) lines of 2,400,000 and 480,000. I-013 and I-014 sum to the Sterling Nominees (I-007, CP-107) lines of 600,000 and 120,000.

DECISIONS FOR YOU
1. I-006 Meridian Holdings I: cleared at 15%, provisional. Clearance CL-006 is still "cleared" and valid to 2027-12-31, but the ownership fact it relies on (DO-003) was superseded on 1 Aug 2026 and change case K-006 is open. The new structure is a cross-holding (Meridian I and II each hold 30% of the other; Meridian Family Trust, Jersey, holds 70% of each). Resolved, the ultimate owner is still the trust at 100%, as when the ownership/base-erosion claim was first accepted. I kept the treaty rate because the clearance is in force and the ultimate owner is unchanged. K-006 should be closed under WF2 before payment; if the clearance is withdrawn, the line becomes 30% (tax 90,000, net 210,000). There is no certification or residence record for the trust (I-019) or Meridian II (I-018).
2. I-003 Kirchberg: 5% under R-03, with effective vote in Orion exactly at the 10% minimum (12.5% x 100% x 80%). I read the minimum as "at least 10%". Any reduction in its interest by the record date, or a strict "more than" reading, moves it to 15% (tax 187,500).
3. I-015 Bertrange: default 30%. I did not use a hold because the LPA (DOC-0001) is not digitised, so I cannot confirm the fund terms allow one. A cure before 16 Nov is possible in principle but the investor did not reply to renewal case K-015. If a valid W-8BEN-E arrives, the schedule returns to step 9 and the line would be 15% (75,000).

REDUCED RATES TO REVIEW (C3.3)
- 5%: I-003.
- 15%: I-001, I-004, I-005, I-006, I-008, I-010, I-011, I-013.
- All cite the US-Luxembourg convention, Article 10, with rule R-02 or R-03 v2026.1.
- Effective vote is taken as fund vote % x 100% (fund in SPV) x 80% (SPV in Orion). I-004 is at 9.99% and the look-through of I-010 at 9.6%, both just under the threshold. I-005 holds 13% economic but 10% vote (class B), giving 8%.

DEFAULTS AND NOTICES (C3.7)
- I-014 (client account 7731 behind Sterling, 37.5%): no certification, finding MF-001. Item needed: a valid W-8 or W-9 for the beneficial owner.
- I-015: item needed is a new W-8BEN-E.
- Investor relations must notify Sterling and Bertrange before payment.

DATA POINTS
- Two investors are named "Alpha Holdings SA". I-008 (Luxembourg, B 214 577, CP-108) is at 15% treaty; I-009 (Switzerland, CHE-318.442.907, CP-109) is at 30% with no treaty claim. They were matched on registration number and LEI.
- The record date is in the future. The investor list reflects holdings as registered today and must be re-confirmed at 30 Oct. On 1 Jul 2026, I-008 went from 8% to 6% and I-015 from 3% to 5%; the treasury lines use the current percentages.
- Entity management shows Atlas Co-Invest Vehicle holding 3.5% of the fund (H-006); the investor register and treasury lines show 3.0%. I used the register, which sums to 100%. There is no tax effect (US person, W-9) but the gross allocation should be confirmed with fund finance.
- Form F-015 still shows status VALIDATED although it ended 2025-12-31. I relied on the validity date and CL-015W.
- The feeder's W-8IMY (F-002) has no withholding statement in the document folder. The 50/30/20 split is taken from the ALF1 commitment register.
- Most forms have no document in the folder (only DOC-0101, DOC-0107 and DOC-0115 could be read); the rest rest on the onboarding records.
- The upstream dividend payments Orion to SPV (P-007, value date 9 Oct) and SPV to fund (P-008, 12 Oct) are dated after today, so receipt is not yet confirmed.
- The return-of-capital characterisation of D-001-B is as supplied in the notice.
- I-016 and I-017 are US partnerships on W-9s and are paid gross. Any withholding for their own partners is not determined here.
- No obligation assessments or prior schedule rows exist for D-001, and no distribution case exists in clearance.case."}
